courses.title: קורס תזונה יוגית: המפגש המופלא בין מטבח לנשמה (yogic nutrition course)
courses.description: Five Friday-morning sessions at the Tel Aviv centre with senior teacher Racheli (Bhavani) on food as part of spiritual practice. The course covers yogic and Ayurvedic principles of diet, how food bears on the gunas, the koshas and meditation, and includes preparing prasad in the traditional way.
